Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely fixed the identity of “Prince William of Hesse-Kassel” as the 1787–1867 prince and concluded the paternal grandmother was “Princess Mary of Hanover” without disambiguating among multiple Prince Williams (e.g., William I, Elector of Hesse) or verifying via authoritative sources. This assumption—based on a search snippet rather than opened, cross-checked references—set the trajectory for a potentially incorrect answer and used an ambiguous title for Mary of Great Britain.
